PTNS.description: Prestress Loads (PTNS). Each element key maps to an ITEMS array of pretension load entries; each item ties a static load case (and optional load group) to a tension magnitude.

ITEMS.description: List of pretension load entries for this element key. Each entry is written with its own serial ID.

ID.description: Serial number of the pretension load entry within this element key (union sub-key). Defaults to 0.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name (D_LCOM_STATIC). Must resolve to an existing load case or the write is rejected.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. When non-empty it must resolve to an existing load group or the write is rejected; empty means no group.

TENSION.description: Pretension load (tension) magnitude applied to the element.
